title: Levels stage ladder feed
description: The observer's dump output as one consumable document (P2-18): the pages a run emitted, in emission order, under the schema_version the stage view negotiates on (devtool.md data layer - a consumer refuses a mismatch loudly instead of misrendering). Producer: the `vize inspector` payload embeds it under `stageFeed`. Transport is deliberately unspecified here - that decision is P2-19.

schema_version.description: Feed format version. Incompatible shape changes bump this.

path.description: Source file the page was produced for, when the producing surface works per-file (the inspector); null for a single-artifact pipeline run.

stage.description: Stage (or stage page family) that produced the page, for example `s1` for the inspector's L1 surface page.

pass.description: Producing step: the pass name for a pipeline dump, or the non-pass step that made the page (`parse` for the L1 surface tree).

text.description: The page text: canonical Full-mode dump text, or for L1 the byte-faithful surface render.

remarks.description: Optimization remarks (P3-13), per file in canonical order: each item is a remarks.schema.json remark item plus the `path` it was produced for, spans in byte offsets into the artifact the pipeline lowered (the frame of that file's pages: the template content for the inspector). Additive to v1: every producer emits it since P3-13; it is optional so earlier v1 documents stay valid. Grammar and vocabulary: docs/davinci/plan/remarks-format.md.

path.description: Source file the remark was produced for; null for a single-artifact pipeline run.
